title: Popular Science Lectures for 11th–12th standard Science Students
teaser: Popular Science Lectures for 11th and 12th standard science students were held at Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi, on 1 November 2018. Eleven schools attended with 192 students.
homepageMatter: Popular Science Lectures for 11th and 12th standard science students were held at S. S. Joshi Hall, Department of Chemistry, Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi, on 1 November 2018. Eleven schools participated, with 192 students attending lectures by Prof. S. C. Lakhotia and Prof. Amitabh Joshi.
